_comment: Instance/organization-specific names live HERE, not in code.
A profile is selected by the target document's project_id (match.project_ids);
if none matches, default_profile is used and a warning is printed.
To support another project or another checklist dialect, add a profile —
no script changes should be needed.

telechips-bsp.description: Telechips BSP module documents (Korean ASPICE checklists)
_fail_count_field: Work item field holding the number of failed checklist items.
The writer sets it from the table it just wrote, so the count and
the checklist can never disagree. Omit it to leave the field alone.
_column_roles: How to find each reviewer column in a checklist header row.
'require' must appear in the header cell, 'forbid' must not.
'판정' appears in BOTH '리뷰 방법 및 판정 기준' (template) and '판정 결과'
(reviewer), so result forbids '기준'. Each role must resolve to exactly
one column or the layout is rejected and no write happens.
_template_columns: Which of the non-reviewer columns carry the item identity. Used to
compare a document's checklist against the official template (match rows
by 'item', report a changed 'criteria'). 'category' may be absent — the
functional-test layout has no 분류 column.
telechips-bsp._defect_section_headings: Headings under which a new defect work item is filed (§7.4).
_templates: The organization's official template documents. Their REVIEW checklists
are fetched at review time and compared against the target document's
checklist, so an out-of-date document checklist can be reported.
